chunks: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali (peace be upon him) guaranteed for us with his book
that the people of knowledge have narrated from him

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali, referring to Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (peace be upon him)
key_terms.أَهْلُ الْعِلْمِ: People of knowledge, referring to scholars and jurists

ai.seo_question: Who attested that the people of knowledge narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Kamal al-Din* underscores the continuity of the Imamate by linking the transmitted knowledge of Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali (Imam al-Baqir) to the broader chain of Ahl al-Bayt, thereby validating the authenticity of Shia jurisprudence. It highlights the scholarly consensus on the reliability of the Imams as the primary sources of divine law, a cornerstone of Usuli thought.
